mods.name: Apple Skin
mods.description: Your hunger and saturation as numbers and as overlays on the food bar, and what the food in your hand would restore.

mods.name: Armor HUD
mods.description: Your armor pieces and how much durability each has left, in a corner of the screen, and your armor value on the armor bar, with extra rows past 20 points.

mods.name: Better Hurt Cam
mods.description: Tone the camera shake down when you are hit, and switch the death tilt off.

mods.name: Better Mount HUD
mods.description: Numbers for the mount you ride: health, speed in blocks per second, jump height and jump charge.

mods.name: Better Stats
mods.description: Search, rank and export your statistics from chat: the biggest entries of each kind, a search across all of them, and a text or CSV file.

mods.name: Chat Heads
mods.description: Shows the sender's face in front of each chat line.

mods.name: Chat Notify
mods.description: Plays a sound when someone says your name in chat.

mods.name: Chat Patches
mods.description: Timestamps in front of chat lines, and an option to drop immediate repeats.

mods.name: Clumps
mods.description: Groups nearby experience orbs into a single orb, which cuts the entity count and is collected at once.

mods.name: Combat Hitboxes
mods.description: Makes entities slightly easier to hit by growing the box your crosshair is tested against.

mods.name: Controlling
mods.description: Find key bindings by action or by key, and list conflicts and unbound actions.

mods.name: CPS Counter
mods.description: Your clicks per second in a corner of the screen.

mods.name: Crafting Tweaks
mods.description: Keys that rotate, balance and clear the crafting grid.

mods.name: Crosshair Indicator
mods.description: Turns your crosshair red when it is over a living creature.

mods.name: Crystal Optimizer
mods.description: Makes End crystals you hit disappear at once on a server, and brings one back if the server did not break it.

mods.name: Custom HUD
mods.description: One box with the lines you pick: FPS, coordinates, facing and clicks per second, on the side you choose.

mods.name: Durability Tooltip
mods.description: Adds a Durability line to the tooltip of tools, weapons and armor.

mods.name: Effect Timer
mods.description: Your active potion effects and how long each has left, red in the last ten seconds, with a duration bar under each effect icon.

mods.name: Enchantment Descriptions
mods.description: Adds a line to enchanted items' tooltips saying what each enchantment does.

mods.name: Entity Crosshair
mods.description: Replaces the crosshair with a style and colour of your choice, red over living entities.

mods.name: Entity Texture Features
mods.description: Random texture variants and emissive layers for mobs, from the textures a resource pack provides.

mods.name: F5 Split
mods.description: Separate keys for the back and the front third-person view, as a toggle or while held.

mods.name: FPS Display
mods.description: Frames per second in a corner of the screen, coloured by how smooth they are.

mods.name: Freecam
mods.description: Detach the camera and fly it around while your player stands still.

mods.name: Freelook
mods.description: Hold a key and move the mouse to look around without turning your player.

mods.name: Info HUD
mods.description: Your speed, the way you face and your dimension in a corner of the screen, in the spirit of MiniHUD's info lines.

mods.name: InvMove
mods.description: Keep walking, jumping and sneaking while your inventory is open.

mods.name: Item Highlighter
mods.description: Marks newly picked-up items with a twinkling star in your inventory.

mods.name: Key Overlay
mods.description: Shows W, A, S, D, jump and the mouse buttons on screen and lights the ones you hold.

mods.name: Litematica
mods.description: Read .litematic schematics: info, and the material list of blocks you need.

mods.name: Minimap Plus
mods.description: Turns Horizon's minimap on and shapes it: corner, size, zoom keys, a big-map key, turning and round or square.

mods.name: More Chat History
mods.description: Chat remembers up to 2000 lines instead of 100, so you can scroll back through a long conversation.

mods.name: Multi Key Bindings
mods.description: More than one key for the same action.

mods.name: Password Hider
mods.description: Shows the password in /login, /register and /changepassword as asterisks while you type, and keeps it out of the chat history and its file.

mods.name: Pearl Optimizer
mods.description: Shows your thrown ender pearl immediately on a server, before the server's pearl arrives.

mods.name: Pick Up Notifier
mods.description: +3 Cobblestone: a short list of what you just picked up (and, if you like, dropped).

mods.name: Ping View
mods.description: Shows your ping to the server: the latest reply, the average of the last 20 and the best and worst.

mods.name: Potion Counter
mods.description: How many potions, splash potions and lingering potions you carry.

mods.name: Search Stats
mods.description: Adds a search box to the statistics screen that filters the Items and Mobs lists as you type.

mods.name: Shield Statuses
mods.description: Your shield's state as a coloured line: ready, blocking, or disabled with the seconds left.

mods.name: Shulker Box Tooltip
mods.description: Shows what is inside a shulker box in its tooltip: totals by item, and a graphical 9 by 3 grid of the items.

mods.name: Simple Zoom
mods.description: Press a key to zoom in and press it again to zoom out; the wheel changes the zoom meanwhile.

mods.name: Snappy Tappy
mods.description: When you hold two opposite movement keys, the one pressed last wins, so you switch direction at once.

mods.name: Sprint Indicator
mods.description: Shows Sprinting, Walking or Sneaking in a corner of the screen while you move.

mods.name: Totem Counter
mods.description: How many totems of undying you carry, red when you have none.

mods.name: Totem Tweaks
mods.description: Customise the totem of undying pop animation: off, speed, size, spin, rocking and position.

mods.name: Tweakeroo
mods.description: Four of Tweakeroo's tweaks: hand restock, hotbar cycle, fast right click and a tool break warning.

mods.name: VisualKeys
mods.description: An on-screen keyboard that shows what every key is bound to and which keys are free.

mods.name: Waypoints
mods.description: Name places with /wp, list them, and track one: its distance and direction show on screen.

mods.name: Zoomify
mods.description: Hold a key to zoom in, turn the wheel to zoom further, with smooth easing and slower turning.
